name: How do I choose the right contractor for my custom home remodel?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my custom home remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right contractor is crucial for a successful custom remodel. Look for a licensed and insured general contractor with experience in projects similar to yours. Check their portfolio, read client testimonials, and verify their references. Discuss their communication style, project management approach, and how they handle unexpected issues. A reliable contractor will provide a detailed proposal and transparent pricing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a licensed, insured contractor with relevant experience. Check their portfolio, references, communication style, and project management approach for transparency.
